title: Power notice (agent to router, binary frame POWER, stream 0)
description: The machine is going to sleep or woke up. On suspending the router takes the node out of routing at once; after resumed it waits for the next heartbeat. The agent repeats its latest notice at the start of each session, before the first heartbeat. A notice without a known state is dropped; so is any notice before approval. Routers before 0.14.0 ignore the frame.

at.description: RFC 3339 time of the event on the agent. Informational; the router uses its receive time.

via.description: Source of the event (for example the Windows power broadcast name); the router keeps up to 40 characters for its journal.
